title: JsonUI Test Progress
description: One record of a test run's progress, emitted by all platform drivers while the run is under way (results.schema.json is written only at the end). One JSON object per line. Web appends to <JSONUI_TEST_PROGRESS_DIR>/<run>.jsonl; Android logs it under the logcat tag JsonUITestProgress at Info; iOS logs it to unified logging, subsystem com.jsonui.testrunner, category progress, public. Consumed by `jui viz`. A driver never lets emitting a record change a test's result. A key is added only with a new `v`.

t.description: Wall-clock time of the event, epoch milliseconds.

run.description: UUID (lower-case) of one runner instance's run; every record of that run carries it.

device.description: run_start, when known: the simulator's name (iOS), Build.MODEL (Android), the browser's name (Web).

deviceId.description: run_start, when known: the simulator's UDID (iOS). Android cannot read its serial from inside the device; a reader knows it from the logcat it reads.

files.description: run_start: the number of test files this run will read.

file.description: The test file as the runner read it, relative to its tests root, '/'-separated.

test.description: The same string as results.json's testName.

case.description: The same string as results.json's caseName. A flow's body is one case.

truncated.description: Present when file, test or case was longer than 200 characters and was cut to 200 followed by '…'; match it to results.json by prefix.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt of the case (a retried case emits one case_start / case_end pair per attempt). 0 only on the single case_end of a case that never ran (status skipped).

status.description: case_end: the attempt's outcome; the last attempt's is the case's.

passed.description: run_end: cases passed, counted as results.json counts them (a retried case once, by its last attempt).
